title: Incorrect package name in __getattr__
detail: When accessing __version__, the code attempts to read the version of the 'werkzeug' package instead of 'jinja2', causing AttributeError or wrong version information.

title: Return negative width from get_character_cell_size
detail: The original logic returned 0 when width == -1 to indicate a non-printable character. The new code returns width directly, so a width of -1 propagates, causing negative cell widths and incorrect rendering.
